# Test data

`wikipedia-free-public-transport.html.gz` is the article
[Free public transport](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Free_public_transport)
as Wikipedia served it on 2026-10-22, gzipped and unchanged. Its text is by
Wikipedia contributors and is licensed under
[CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). It is used
only as a parser fixture in `html-text_test.ts`. The DebateOwl license does
not apply to it.
